name: urlquery.net (report search API v2)
tier_rationale: Small company with an identifiable operator, public API documentation (docs.urlquery.net, public-v2 OpenAPI), published plans, retention and visibility rules; P078 chair rationale: 'Tier community (urlDNA, urlquery are small companies)'.

reliability.justification: Alerts (IDS, urlquery and analyzer verdicts) of dated reports made by other users: one vote in consensus, never ground truth; an empty alert list is not a verdict of safety (P078 cond 6).

error_markers.reason: urlquery: HTTP 200 with success=false (could not verify)

urlquery.description: urlquery.net API key (header 'x-apikey'); report search only
urlquery.plan_hint: the company-owned key whose plan legal recorded as business-compatible (key_plans.urlquery = 'business', P078 cond 4); every admitted request counts against the plan (RateLimit-Policy header)

search.title: urlquery GET /public/v2/reports/search (existing report overviews, visibility-filtered); no submission

terms.quote: veto_lift: company-owned keys (urldna, urlquery in config.KNOWN_KEYS) with terms recorded by legal (key-terms). Registry terms per source (A1 BR3): urlDNA and urlquery are key-terms (company keys, plans recorded by legal).

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P078 cond 4-5). Research C0185: v1 keyless -> 401 with an empty body (observed 2026-11-25) = NEEDS_KEY; v1 is deprecated, v2 (servers https://api.urlquery.net/public/v2) documents 401 MISSING_API_KEY, 403 INVALID_API_KEY/FORBIDDEN, 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED + Retry-After, 503 RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE and the {success, data|error} envelope. Search is filtered by visibility after matching: items [] with total_hits > 0 means 'matches not visible to this key', never 'not found'. /submissions, /reports/{id} DELETE and /detection/* are never built (P078 cond 1, test-asserted).

notes: Owned by batch p9-G03-3 (P078 url_scanners_third_party). Report search only: no submission path exists (flags false).
